content: Android 17 background audio hardening applies to all apps on Android 17: background playback, audio focus requests and volume APIs fail (often silently) unless app has visible activity or a non-SHORT_SERVICE FGS. Targeting API 37 additionally requires FGS with while-in-use capability. Guidance: start mediaPlayback FGS from foreground on user-initiated play, keep it through transient failures (<10 min), stop at end, restart only on explicit user resume.
